description: Davidson public course API (api.davidson.edu), real responses captured 2026-09-30, minified; contact e-mail addresses in descriptions replaced. Every term W1 ingests (202201 through 202603) is covered: full Fall 2026 (202601) and Spring 2027 (202602), subsets of 202201-202502, [] for summer terms and for second pages. Any other request fails loudly.
